posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-nexterm 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH 会话中运维 Nexterm 托管的 SSH 机群：6 个 agent 工具（密码/TOTP/设备授权码登录认证、机群清单、单机执行、批量并行执行、预设健康检查、CPU/内存/磁盘监控），全走 Nexterm REST API，附极简设置页；DSH 机器上无需任何 SSH 私钥。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-257d577a9d06d1b0d546.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-nexterm is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Nexterm fleet maintenance in a DSH session: 6 agent tools (auth with password/TOTP/device-code login, fleet listing, single-host exec, parallel batch exec, preset health checks, CPU/memory/disk monitoring) over the Nexterm REST API, plus a minimal settings page; no SSH private keys needed on the DSH machine.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-257d577a9d06d1b0d546.html
